analysis_notes.evil_mirror_gap_note: Torah #12 presents a pronounced EVIL MIRROR structure (יעקב vs. לבן; the Tanna vs. the false scholar; holy neshikin vs. the unwanted/rejected kiss) that is almost entirely absent from the bechina dataset for ref=12. The evil side appears in multiple eitza edges (the false scholar speaks against the tzaddik, etc.) but is not represented in any bechina edges. This is a systematic gap: the evil cluster (לבן, תלמיד חכם שד יהודי, הורמיז בר לילתא, גלות השכינה, נשיקות שונא) has no bechina connections in the dataset. Adding the core evil-identity bechina (לבן ↔ תלמיד חכם שד יהודי) is the highest priority addition.
analysis_notes.summary: All 25 nodes with bechina edges for reference=12 are assigned to packages. The main gaps are: (1) שכינה ↔ תורה שבעל פה — the central identity equation of this Torah is missing; (2) לבן ↔ תלמיד חכם שד יהודי — the primary evil bechina is absent, leaving no evil package for ref=12; (3) מלכות ↔ פה — the Patach Eliyahu equation underlying the entire Torah is absent; (4) the Netzach/Hod upper lips = neshikin connection is absent from the dataset. The Torah's evil-mirror structure (the entire לבן/שד dimension) is structurally underrepresented in bechina edges.
